Senses.Note: Seven exact witnesses across five independent works support one Linji-house device; component formulas are family controls, not extra exact-headword sources.

Senses.Explanation: Linji-house records use this paired label for a verbal device that a single phrase or shout is said to contain, and later teachers enumerate, test, or tell hearers to discard it. Fenyang Shanzhao says that one phrase contains the three mysteries and three essentials, with guest and host clearly distinguished; his verse also calls them difficult to distinguish and turns from words to their intended point. Huiyan Zhizhao says that one shout encompasses them. Tianyin Yuanxiu identifies the device with Linji and simultaneous illumination and function. Qiran Chaozhi asks which phrase is the three-mysteries-and-three-essentials phrase and elsewhere tells hearers to remove it together with other Linji-house arrangements. Jie'an Wujin lists it among the devices marking the Linji family.
